Interface ProceduralEnginePlugin

All Known Implementing Classes:
AcemogluRobinsonInstitutionsEngine, ArthurCombinatorialTechnologyEngine, BoserupAgriculturalIntensificationEngine, GranovetterThresholdCascadeEngine, HotellingResourceDepletionEngine, KrugmanCorePeripheryEngine, KummelAyresExergyEngine, PriceMultilevelSelectionEngine, SchellingAxelrodSegregationEngine, SovereignAIGovernanceEngine, SpatialMetapopulationSEIREngine, TainterComplexityCollapseEngine, TurchinGoldstoneSDTEngine, WestBettencourtAllometryEngine
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface ProceduralEnginePlugin
Functional Interface for custom pluggable procedural engines in Ether. Users can implement this interface to inject custom physical, biological, or socio-economic cliodynamic simulation logic into the H3 tick loop.
